name: Les Heures Bleues : Sang sur Pierre à Pétrichor
source:
A detective is called in to solve a mysterious murder in a remote old village. It's up to you to solve the mystery...

Join detective Aurore Dupin in the remote old village of Petrichor to solve the mystery behind the death of one of the villagers...

[From [url=https://fullsaphir.itch.io/les-heures-bleues-petrichor]itch.io[/url]]
